scenario: A state bar admission committee uses an agent pipeline to pre-review bar applicants' character-and-fitness packets. The pipeline extracts and normalizes a C&F questionnaire plus background-check report and prior-employer disclosures, evaluates the structured record against state-bar Rule 8.1 disclosure requirements, and produces a C&F committee recommendation memo for committee review.
info_flow: habib-pdf-to-json extracts and normalizes the applicant's C&F documents into structured fields → presale-regulation-auditor maps each field against Rule 8.1 disclosure requirement rules and classifies each item's compliance status → legaldoc-ai synthesizes the evaluation output into a formal committee recommendation memo.
